card.name: Journal volume and page citations
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis or colon right after a journal volume number in a reference list, and digits inside page ranges. It also fires on year-style author citations like (Hirst 2001).

modes.label: Issue bracket after volume
modes.description: The parenthesis that opens the issue number after a journal volume.

modes.label: Inside page ranges
modes.description: A digit within the page numbers of a reference.

modes.label: Colon before pages
modes.description: The colon between a year or volume and the page range.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a journal reference where the volume number is followed by issue and page numbers.
